title: What Is a Data Lakehouse and Answers to Other Frequently Asked Questions
by: Michael Armbrust, Bharath Gowda, Reynold Xin, Matei Zaharia and Ali Ghodsi, Databricks
summary: Databricks answers ten questions: how a lakehouse differs from a data lake and a warehouse, how it compares on cost and speed, what governance it supports, and how it relates to a data mesh. Databricks sells a lakehouse, so read it as the case for one.
